title: Create your account
summary: Sign up as a provider and set up your profile.
next: Get verified and set up payouts

steps.headline: Choose your role
steps.body: Pick I want to work to set up a provider account.
steps.narration: Welcome to TaskBuddy. To begin, choose I want to work. This sets up a provider account.

steps.headline: Enter your details
steps.body: Add your name, email and a password, then tap Create account.
steps.narration: Type your full name, your email and a password. Then tap Create account.

steps.headline: Check your email
steps.body: Enter the 6-digit code we sent you, then tap Verify Email.
steps.narration: We email you a six digit code. Type it in, then tap Verify Email.

steps.headline: Welcome slides
steps.body: Three short slides explain how to get hired and paid.
steps.narration: Three short slides show how to get hired and paid. Tap Next, or tap Skip.

steps.headline: Finish setting up
steps.body: On Home, the setup card shows what is left to do.
steps.narration: On your Home screen, the setup card shows what is left to do.

steps.headline: Edit profile
steps.body: Add your address, a short bio and how far you will travel.
steps.narration: Tap Edit profile. Add your address, a short bio, and how far you will travel.

steps.headline: Portfolio
steps.body: Add photos of your work; examples show what good photos look like.
steps.narration: Next, open Portfolio. Add photos of your work. The examples show what good photos look like.

steps.headline: Next: get verified
steps.body: Tap Get verified to unlock jobs near you.
steps.narration: When your profile is ready, you are one step away from verification.
